arena.topic: Should we invest in AI infrastructure this quarter?
arena.context: Q1 budget planning meeting. The company has $500k available for infrastructure investment.

personas.name: Sarah Chen
personas.description: Chief Financial Officer. Conservative, data-driven, focused on ROI and risk management.
personas.background: 20 years in corporate finance. Skeptical of hype cycles. Wants to see clear business cases with measurable outcomes.

personas.name: Marcus Thompson
personas.description: Chief Technology Officer. Forward-thinking technologist excited about AI's potential.
personas.background: Former startup founder. Believes in first-mover advantage. Worried about falling behind competitors.

personas.name: Jennifer Park
personas.description: Chief Operating Officer. Pragmatic operator focused on execution and team capacity.
personas.background: Manages day-to-day operations. Concerned about implementation burden on existing teams. Values incremental improvement.
